lines.en: : Sensei! Come look at my sword!
: It’s sharp enough to cut three bodies in one strike!
: I’m sure it is, Ayane. I can see it from here. It’s very nice.
: I will use this blade to defend our children.
: I’m sure you will.
Okay, so maybe not everyone is studying diligently.
In fact, only Makoto is. But that’s basically how things are in here now.
I’m not too worried, though. I mean, everyone seems confident enough to pass at least most of the subjects.
I’m not sure how grading for these things goes, but I’m sure you don’t have to pass every subject, right?...
Oh well. They’ll be fine. It would be incredibly disruptive to the plot if they weren’t.
Sana suddenly raises her hand and I can hear her ellipses from the back of the room.
It’s not like her to command my attention in class...I wonder if something is wrong?
: Hey, Sana. Do you need something?
: Um...Not particularly...
: You just...seemed bored...so I thought I’d wave you over and...
: You wanted to see if I wanted to talk, right?
: R-right...
: I’m still...not really friends with anyone else and...
: And Ayane has a sword for some reason...
: Are you surprised by this?
: I think I should be, but...no...
: W-What?! You mean...like...right now?...
: With everyone watching?...
: No one is even looking at you.
: What else is new?...
: Sana...even if people were looking at you, it shouldn’t change anything.
: Please...don’t try to sabotage me, Sensei...I have a hard enough time as is...
: Well, how about this? I’ll make the first move for you.
: Wait...what? First move? What are you going to do?...
: Something I should have done a long time ago...
: I don’t like the sound of this...
: It’s okay. Just think about all of our training.
: You’ve...barely even taught me anything...
: Hey, Rin.
: Hm? Sensei? What’s up?
: Not much. How are you doing?
Sana suddenly begins to tug on my sleeve.
: Um...S-Sensei...
: Uhh...I mean, I’m pretty good I guess. Just looking outside the window and stuff.
: I’d...agree? I just don’t know what else to do instead.
: Futaba is reading and stuff and she doesn’t like being bothered in the middle of that.
: Uh...umm...
The tugging grows stronger.
: Well how about you talk to Sana, then?
: I mean, sure. I’d love to.
: She’s just always so quiet that I didn’t think she really wanted to talk to anybody.
: Um...I would...love to talk!
: See? That wasn’t so hard, was it?
: Just talk to Rin the same way you talk to me and everything will be fine.
: Will you...stay and make sure I do everything right?
: Nope. Your mission begins now.
: Have fun!
: What?!
: Ah-!
: Cool! Mission text!
: Uh...umm...ahh...
: Hey, Sana! What’s up?
: Um...nothing! Wh-What’s...up...with you?
: Oh, you know. Just hangin’ around the classroom, doing classroom stuff. Same old, same old.
: The two of us haven’t really talked before, have we?
In order to get a good look, though, I need to stand right next to Ayane.
Which of course means I need to continuously swat her hand away from me every three seconds.
: Um...no...we haven’t...
: I’ve always...wanted to, but...
: It’s okay. Take your time.
: I get nervous around new people, too. Don’t worry about it.
: R-Right! Th...thanks...
: Of course! So, is there anything you’d like to talk about?
: You play games and stuff, right?
As expected, Rin takes the lead in the conversation and begins to steer Sana back into her comfort zone.
I think back to the other day when I was hanging out with Sara and Haruka.
I remember thinking then that it was weird these two had never gotten to know each other.
And, given Sana’s current skill level when it comes to public speaking, Rin is probably a great option for a first non-Ayane friend.
: Y-Yes! I love games! Do you...um...
: Do you play anything, Rin?...
Great job, Sana- already calling her by her name.
I’m sure Rin doesn’t care about (Or even notice) things like that, but I’m still proud regardless.
: Senseiiiii~
: Ayane, stop touching me.
: Boo...
: Of course!
: So like...MMO’s? Or do you like shooters more?...
: Shooters. The more they bleed, the stronger I become...
: H-huh?...
: Is this...what bullying is?...
: Are you...trying to intimidate me?...
: What?! No! Of course not! That was just a joke!
: I like shooters, yeah, but I don’t actually become stronger by consuming peoples’ blood or anything.
: I was just playing around. I’m not bullying you at all.
: Huh?...You’ve...
: Really?
: Of course! You’ve just always seemed kinda...distant.
: Um...well...if it’s not a bother...I...
: I wouldn’t mind being your...friend...
: Really? Awesome! That’s great news!
: Maybe the two of us could hang out sometime then!
: You’re literally in the room connected to mine, so it’s not like you don’t know where to find me.
: I’d...love to! Thank you so much!
: Dude, you don’t have to thank me.
: Okay! Thank you!
: Oh, I mean, umm...
: Hey! We did it!
: Where are these letters coming from?...
I wait a minute before returning to Sana’s desk to congratulate her on a job well done.
: Sensei! Did you...did you see what happened?!
: I made a friend!
: I did. You were great, Sana. Like I’ve been saying, it’s not that hard to-
: No, it was totally hard! I almost cried!
: But I didn’t! I pulled through!
: And now I have a new friend!
: Wait...I have to be friends with everyone?...
: That’s right. Keep working hard, Sana.
: But...I was barely even able to make one...
And the fact is, she doesn’t.
It’s rare that anyone in any class is ever friends with everyone.
But in Sana’s case, I think it’s a good idea.
Or, at least it’s one of the only ways I can think of getting her to open up more for now...
Oh well.
We’ll just have to see how things go from here on out.
Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!
